name: Seychelles (colony, 1961–1976)
description: A British Blue Ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and the colonial badge of Seychelles, a giant tortoise beneath a coco de mer palm on a disc, in the fly.
history: Blue Ensign defaced with the badge of the Crown Colony of Seychelles in the form redesigned in 1961, replacing the badge designed by Charles George Gordon in 1903. It was replaced on 29 June 1976, the day of independence, by the blue, red and white saltire flag.

features.role: colonial badge with tortoise and coco de mer palm
